dod_intent_evidence: CEO 'landing their first DoD contract at 22' and CTO 'delivered solutions to Anduril, the US Air Force, NOAA, and the Ukrainian army' (About page); 1st Cavalry Division testing Golden Shield and NATO DIANA 2026 selection (News section).
score_evidence: '20x cheaper than the next best interceptor' and '1 minute' reload are operational/cost specs, not lab vanity metrics → lab_language_intensity low

'Designed from the ground up for RF-contested, GPS-denied environments... Don't emit. Don't die. Unlike EW systems, Spotter keeps you radio-silent' — explicit DDIL-equivalent design language → deployment_awareness_absence low
'Spike minimizes cognitive load for the warfighter with hands-free detection' and direct Ukrainian commander testimonials → operator_absence low

open roles are AI engineer, robotics simulation ('Wargamer'), embedded/electrical ('Bitcaster') — hardware domain-engineering hires are neutral per checklist, no compliance/BD hire visible → hiring_profile_skew
7-11 employees, founded 2024, a16z Speedrun cohort (pre-seed accelerator) → stage_pressure high

blind_spots.blind_spot: Spotter's sensor-fusion track data has no stated path into a higher command's C2/TAK picture — the product is described purely as a standalone find-fix-finish loop.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A counter-drone sensor that can't format its detections for the battalion's TAK/C2 picture stays a gadget the truck crew loves but the S2 never adopts into the broader air-picture — 'operators loving it is not adoption.'
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team of 7-11 is focused on core kinetic and perception R&D, not yet on software/C2 integration.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Spotter tracks FPV drones in all directions using passive sensor fusion and optional W-band low-emission radar.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention of a spares/resupply/battery-logistics pipeline for an attritable, mass-expended interceptor system.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A '48 Seeker' magazine of 250g attritable interceptors implies theater-scale consumption; without a stated manufacturing/resupply plan, sustainment collapses exactly when the fight is heaviest — the same gap that kills a fielded system after the demo.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Pre-seed team still proving the core kill-chain, not yet at production/sustainment scale.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Spike can be fitted with up to 48 Seeker interceptors. Reload each launchpad in under 1 minute.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Hiring is 100% core R&D (AI, robotics sim, embedded/electrical) with no capture/BD/advocacy hire, despite the company already having glowing Ukrainian-operator praise but only a U.S. Army test ('trialled'), not a funded program of record.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Operator love from Ukrainian brigade commanders is not a funded U.S. champion above the operator level — without someone driving that conversion, the 1st Cav test risks staying a demo while the seed clock runs out.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Tiny team (7-11) at pre-seed stage still building the product itself.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Wargamer (Robotics Simulation Engineer) ... Bitcaster (Embedded Systems / Electrical)

opener_hook: 1st Cavalry Division just tested Spike under the Golden Shield layered-defense trial — what's the funded path from that test to a program of record?
what_they_do: Portable autonomous counter-drone hardware — a passive sensor (Spotter) paired with attritable kinetic interceptors (Seeker) — built for RF-contested, GPS-denied battlefield defense.
